```{r}
df_clean <- df
df_clean[df_clean == ""] <- NA
df_clean$Belief <- as.character(df_clean$Belief)

df_clean$Belief[df_clean$Belief %in% c("Y", "Yes")] <- "Yes"
df_clean$Belief[df_clean$Belief %in% c("N", "No")]  <- "No"

# 
df_clean$Belief[!df_clean$Belief %in% c("Yes", "No")] <- NA

df_clean$Belief <- factor(df_clean$Belief, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
for (v in c("PH", "MH")) {
  df_clean[[v]] <- as.character(df_clean[[v]])
  df_clean[[v]][df_clean[[v]] %in% c("Y", "Yes")] <- "Yes"
  df_clean[[v]][df_clean[[v]] %in% c("N", "No")]  <- "No"
  df_clean[[v]][!df_clean[[v]] %in% c("Yes", "No")] <- NA
  df_clean[[v]] <- factor(df_clean[[v]], levels = c("No", "Yes"))
}
df_clean$Gender <- as.character(df_clean$Gender)

df_clean$Gender[df_clean$Gender == "M"]    <- "Male"
df_clean$Gender[df_clean$Gender == "F"]    <- "Female"
df_clean$Gender[df_clean$Gender == "GD"]   <- "Gender diverse"
df_clean$Gender[df_clean$Gender == "PNTS"] <- "Prefer not to say"

df_clean$Gender <- factor(
  df_clean$Gender,
  levels = c("Male", "Female", "Gender diverse", "Prefer not to say")
)
df_clean$Smoker <- as.character(df_clean$Smoker)

df_clean$Smoker[df_clean$Smoker %in% c("Y", "Yes", "Current")] <- "Yes"
df_clean$Smoker[df_clean$Smoker %in% c("N", "No")] <- "No"

df_clean$Smoker[!df_clean$Smoker %in% c("Yes", "No")] <- NA

df_clean$Smoker <- factor(df_clean$Smoker, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
df_clean$Age[df_clean$Age == 0] <- NA
df_clean$SES5 <- factor(
  df_clean$SES5,
  levels = c("L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "L5"),
  ordered = TRUE
)
str(df_clean)
summary(df_clean)

table(df_clean$Belief, useNA = "ifany")
table(df_clean$PH, useNA = "ifany")
table(df_clean$MH, useNA = "ifany")
table(df_clean$Gender, useNA = "ifany")

```

```{r}
model_primary <- glm(
  Belief ~ PH + MH,
  data = df_clean,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_primary)

```


```{r}
prop.table(table(df_clean$PH))
prop.table(table(df_clean$MH))

```

22.2% of participants reported a physical health issue, and 31.8% reported a mental health issue.


```{r}
#Q2
model_PH <- glm(
  PH ~ Age + Gender + SES5 + Smoker,
  data = df_clean,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_PH)


model_MH <- glm(
  MH ~ Age + Gender + SES5 + Smoker,
  data = df_clean,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_MH)

# after rejust  prevalence
mean(predict(model_PH, type = "response"), na.rm = TRUE)
mean(predict(model_MH, type = "response"), na.rm = TRUE)


```

```{r}
#Q3
summary(df_clean$Age)
prop.table(table(df_clean$Gender))
prop.table(table(df_clean$SES5))
prop.table(table(df_clean$PH))
prop.table(table(df_clean$MH))
prop.table(table(df_clean$Smoker))

```
